notes.grade: The only gauntlet with an enabled sun: an open canyon under a declared blue sky, so the look grades it and paints its sky, as it should (aliases sunmane_gauntlet_2 and _3 load the same map). Measured in Forward+ at the spawn (0, 7), pitch -60 and -30, against develop's compatibility frame. Untrimmed, the red sandstone washed out to a pale pink: world saturation 0.53 to 0.39, warmth (R-B) 84 to 53. saturation_forward 1.3 gives 0.48 and warmth 69 at the play camera and 0.49 at the low view, inside the look's 0.45-0.52 band. Luminance is already develop's (117), so there is no exposure trim. The compatibility renderer was not measured, so it keeps the defaults.
